scope: Disposable local PostgreSQL 16/pgvector cluster with two synthetic members and manual company data
limits: This verifies a same-cluster local restore of synthetic pilot data. It does not prove target cloud backup storage, off-host retention, cross-cluster restore, live writes during backup, actual team access, or later real business data migration. The standalone backup command retains its archive and manifest in an operator-specified directory outside Git; the integration verifier removes its disposable copy.
